inventory.literal: Closed bulb-like glass tube with long oblique upper neck/window, hatched wall, left projection, and two sealed electrode leads.
Thick near-vertical left electrode receiving rays; thick vertical right electrode connected to the ammeter branch.
Five parallel diagonal arrowed rays run from upper right through the window toward the left electrode; all ray endpoints and arrowheads retained.
Four hollow circles inside the tube, each paired with a rightward arrow toward the right electrode.

inventory.label: V
inventory.literal: One round V meter in the horizontal mid-level branch between left node and central wiper node.

inventory.label: mA
inventory.literal: One round mA meter on the right lead, joined to the mid-level return branch.
Horizontal rectangular resistor in lower branch; downward arrowed wiper from central mid-level node to resistor.
Two battery-cell pairs with alternating short/thick and long/thin vertical strokes; central dashed connection.

Complete left vertical return, mid branch, lower resistor branch, bottom battery branch, right battery return and right meter lead. Three filled joining nodes at two left branch junctions and central mid-level/wiper junction.
